newsitem.title: USA: UNITED DENTAL CARE INC FILES IPO.
newsitem.headline: UNITED DENTAL CARE INC FILES IPO.

text.p: United Dental Care Inc. filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday for an offering of 2.0 million shares of common stock.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to fund pending acquisitions, pay existing debt and for general corporate purposes, including working capital, the company said.
An underwriting group led by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc. has an over-allotment option to buy an additional 300,000 shares, it said.
